class.name: MaszynaMoverRailVehicleElectricSeriesEngine
class.description: [RailVehicleElectricSeriesEngine] simulated by the vendored Mover ([code]TMoverParameters[/code]): its configuration is written into the vehicle's Mover and its live values are read straight from it. Created by the FIZ import for a vehicle [MaszynaMoverVehicleServer] simulates; everything else reaches it through [RailVehicleElectricSeriesEngine].

method.name: get_eimic_real
method.description: The traction an EIM controller actually asks for, -1-1 ([code]eimic_real[/code]).

members.member: What the Mover's model of the electric engine's circuit is configured with.
What the Mover's model of the engine is configured with beyond its facts, read by the drive.
[code]RList:RVentCutOff[/code] Starting resistor value below which the cooling fans stop running (used when [member resistor_fan_type] is Automatic).
[code]RList:RVentMinI[/code] Minimum current, in amperes, at which the cooling fans switch on.
[code]RList:RVentSpeed[/code] Cooling fan spin-up rate, in the range 0..1.
[code]RList:DynBrakeRes[/code] Resistance of the resistors during ED (dynamic) braking, for two motors combined, in ohms.
[code]RList:DynBrakeRes1[/code] Primary ED braking resistance on the third stage, when it has two resistance levels, in ohms.
[code]RList:DynBrakeRes2[/code] ED braking resistance used at low speeds on the third stage, when it has two resistance levels, in ohms.
[code]RList[/code] Automatic starting sequence table: for each resistor-start controller position (starting from 1, not counting position 0), the starting resistance and motor branch configuration.
